question: Must `9f22a0dcf33d9528cd7e392c09d31aef6a945655` complete the privileged GCP lifecycle before merge, or is the earlier successful Compute request plus exact-head token, IAM-denial, SHA-verification, and cleanup evidence sufficient?

options.title: Require exact-head lifecycle

options.title: Accept split proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the earlier successful Compute request together with exact-head token acquisition, fail-closed IAM behavior, SHA verification, and cleanup.
